en: Muhammad ibn Rafi narrated to us. Abd al-Razzaq narrated to us. Ubayd Allah ibn Umar informed us, from Nafi, from Ibn Umar, that the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) departed on the Day of Sacrifice, then returned and prayed the noon prayer at Mina. Nafi said: Ibn Umar used to depart on the Day of Sacrifice, then return and pray the noon prayer at Mina, and he mentioned that the Prophet (peace be upon him) had done this.
de: Muhammad ibn Rafi überlieferte uns. Abd al-Razzaq überlieferte uns. Ubayd Allah ibn Umar berichtete uns, from Nafi, from Ibn Umar, dass der Gesandte Allahs (Friede sei auf ihm) departed on the Opfertag, then returned and betete the Mittagsgebet at Mina. Nafi said: Ibn Umar pflegte zu depart on the Opfertag, then return and pray the Mittagsgebet at Mina, and he mentioned dass der Prophet (Friede sei auf ihm) had done this. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut dieser Überlieferung bleiben erhalten.

en: Zuhayr ibn Harb narrated to me. Ishaq ibn Yusuf al-Azraq narrated to us. Sufyan informed us, from Abd al-Aziz ibn Rufa'i. He said: I asked Anas ibn Malik. I said: Tell me something you understood from the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him): where did he pray the noon prayer on the Day of Tarwiyah? He said: At Mina. I said: Where did he pray the afternoon prayer on the Day of Departure? He said: At al-Abtah. Then he said: Do what your commanders do.
de: Zuhayr ibn Harb überlieferte mir. Ishaq ibn Yusuf al-Azraq überlieferte uns. Sufyan berichtete uns, from Abd al-Aziz ibn Rufa'i. Er sagte: I asked Anas ibn Malik. I said: Tell me something you understood from der Gesandte Allahs (Friede sei auf ihm): wo did he pray the Mittagsgebet on the Day of Tarwiyah? Er sagte: At Mina. I said: Where did he pray the afterMittagsgebet on the Day of Departure? Er sagte: At al-Abtah. Then he said: Do what your commanders do. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut dieser Überlieferung bleiben erhalten.

en: Muhammad ibn Mihran al-Razi narrated to us. Abd al-Razzaq narrated to us, from Ma'mar, from Ayyub, from Nafi, from Ibn Umar, that the Prophet (peace be upon him), Abu Bakr, and Umar used to descend at al-Abtah.
de: Muhammad ibn Mihran al-Razi überlieferte uns. Abd al-Razzaq überlieferte uns, from Ma'mar, from Ayyub, from Nafi, from Ibn Umar, dass der Prophet (Friede sei auf ihm), Abu Bakr, and Umar pflegte zu descend at al-Abtah. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut dieser Überlieferung bleiben erhalten.

en: Muhammad ibn Hatim ibn Maymun narrated to me. Rawh ibn Ubadah narrated to us. Sakhr ibn Juwayriya narrated to us, from Nafi, that Ibn Umar used to regard al-Tahsib as sunnah, and he used to pray the noon prayer on the Day of Departure at al-Hasbah. Nafi said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) and the caliphs after him had camped there.
de: Muhammad ibn Hatim ibn Maymun überlieferte mir. Rawh ibn Ubadah überlieferte uns. Sakhr ibn Juwayriya überlieferte uns, from Nafi, dass Ibn Umar pflegte zu regard al-Tahsib as Sunna, and he pflegte zu pray the Mittagsgebet on the Day of Departure at al-Hasbah. Nafi said: Der Gesandte of Allah (Friede sei auf ihm) and the caliphs after him had camped there. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut dieser Überlieferung bleiben erhalten.

en: Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah and Abu Kurayb both narrated to us. They said: Abd Allah ibn Numayr narrated to us. Hisham narrated to us, from his father, from Aisha. She said: Descending at al-Abtah is not a sunnah. The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) only descended there because it was easier for him to leave when he departed.
de: Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah and Abu Kurayb both überlieferte uns. They said: Abd Allah ibn Numayr überlieferte uns. Hisham überlieferte uns, from his father, from Aisha. Sie sagte: Descending at al-Abtah is not a Sunna. Der Gesandte of Allah (Friede sei auf ihm) only descended there because it was easier for him to leave when he departed. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut dieser Überlieferung bleiben erhalten.

en: Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah narrated to us. Hafs ibn Ghiyath narrated to us. H; and Abu al-Rabi narrated to me. al-Zahrani narrated to us. Hammad, meaning Ibn Zayd, narrated to us. H; and Abu Kamil narrated to us. Yazid ibn Zuray narrated to us. Habib al-Mu'allim narrated to us. All of them narrated from Hisham, with this chain, something similar.
de: Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah überlieferte uns. Hafs ibn Ghiyath überlieferte uns. H; and Abu al-Rabi überlieferte mir. al-Zahrani überlieferte uns. Hammad, meaning Ibn Zayd, überlieferte uns. H; and Abu Kamil überlieferte uns. Yazid ibn Zuray überlieferte uns. Habib al-Mu'allim überlieferte uns. All of them narrated from Hisham, with this chain, something similar. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut dieser Überlieferung bleiben erhalten.

en: Abd ibn Humayd narrated to us. Abd al-Razzaq informed us. Ma'mar informed us, from al-Zuhri, from Salim, that Abu Bakr, Umar, and Ibn Umar used to descend at al-Abtah. Al-Zuhri said: Urwah informed me, from Aisha, that she did not do this, and she said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) only descended there because it was an easier place for him to leave.
de: Abd ibn Humayd überlieferte uns. Abd al-Razzaq berichtete uns. Ma'mar berichtete uns, from al-Zuhri, from Salim, dass Abu Bakr, Umar, and Ibn Umar pflegte zu descend at al-Abtah. Al-Zuhri said: Urwah berichtete mir, from Aisha, dass she did not do this, and she said: Der Gesandte of Allah (Friede sei auf ihm) only descended there because it was an easier place for him to leave. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut dieser Überlieferung bleiben erhalten.

en: Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah, Ishaq ibn Ibrahim, Ibn Abi Umar, and Ahmad ibn Abdah narrated to us. Abu Bakr's wording is used. Sufyan ibn Uyaynah narrated to us, from Amr, from Ata, from Ibn Abbas, who said: Al-Tahsib is nothing. It is only a place where the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) descended.
de: Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah, Ishaq ibn Ibrahim, Ibn Abi Umar, and Ahmad ibn Abdah überlieferte uns. Abu Bakr's wording is used. Sufyan ibn Uyaynah überlieferte uns, from Amr, from Ata, from Ibn Abbas, who said: Al-Tahsib is nothing. It is only a place wo der Gesandte Allahs (Friede sei auf ihm) descended. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut dieser Überlieferung bleiben erhalten.

en: Qutaybah ibn Sa'id, Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah, and Zuhayr ibn Harb all narrated to us, from Ibn Uyaynah. Zuhayr said: Sufyan ibn Uyaynah narrated to us, from Salih ibn Kaysan, from Sulayman ibn Yasar, who said: Abu Rafi said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) did not command me to descend at al-Abtah when he left Mina. I came and struck his tent, and he came and descended. In Abu Bakr's narration, Salih said: I heard Sulayman ibn Yasar. In Qutaybah's narration, he said: From Abu Rafi, and he was responsible for the Prophet's baggage.
de: Qutaybah ibn Sa'id, Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah, and Zuhayr ibn Harb all überlieferte uns, from Ibn Uyaynah. Zuhayr said: Sufyan ibn Uyaynah überlieferte uns, from Salih ibn Kaysan, from Sulayman ibn Yasar, who said: Abu Rafi said: Der Gesandte of Allah (Friede sei auf ihm) did not command me to descend at al-Abtah when he left Mina. I came and struck his tent, and he came and descended. In Abu Bakr's narration, Salih said: I heard Sulayman ibn Yasar. In Qutaybah's narration, he said: From Abu Rafi, and he was responsible for the Prophet's baggage. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut dieser Überlieferung bleiben erhalten.

en: Harmalah ibn Yahya narrated to me. Ibn Wahb informed us. Yunus informed me, from Ibn Shihab, from Abu Salamah ibn Abd al-Rahman ibn Awf, from Abu Hurayra, from the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him), that he said: We will descend tomorrow, if Allah wills, at Khayf Banu Kinanah, where they swore an oath concerning disbelief.
de: Harmalah ibn Yahya überlieferte mir. Ibn Wahb berichtete uns. Yunus berichtete mir, from Ibn Shihab, from Abu Salamah ibn Abd al-Rahman ibn Awf, from Abu Hurayra, from der Gesandte Allahs (Friede sei auf ihm), dass he said: We will descend tomorrow, if Allah wills, at Khayf Banu Kinanah, wo they swore an oath concerning disbelief. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut dieser Überlieferung bleiben erhalten.

en: Zuhayr ibn Harb narrated to us. al-Walid ibn Muslim narrated to us. al-Awza'i narrated to me. Al-Zuhri narrated to me. Abu Salamah narrated to us. Abu Hurayra said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) said while we were at Mina: Tomorrow, if Allah wills, we will descend at Khayf Banu Kinanah, where they swore an oath concerning disbelief. That was because Quraysh and Banu Kinanah had allied against Banu Hashim and Banu al-Muttalib, agreeing not to marry with them or trade with them until they handed the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) over to them. He meant by that al-Muhassab.
de: Zuhayr ibn Harb überlieferte uns. al-Walid ibn Muslim überlieferte uns. al-Awza'i überlieferte mir. Al-Zuhri überlieferte mir. Abu Salamah überlieferte uns. Abu Hurayra said: Der Gesandte of Allah (Friede sei auf ihm) said while we were at Mina: Tomorrow, if Allah wills, we will descend at Khayf Banu Kinanah, wo they swore an oath concerning disbelief. That was because Quraysh and Banu Kinanah had allied against Banu Hashim and Banu al-Muttalib, agreeing not to marry with them or trade with them until they handed der Gesandte Allahs (Friede sei auf ihm) over to them. He meant by dass al-Muhassab. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut dieser Überlieferung bleiben erhalten.

en: Zuhayr ibn Harb narrated to me. Shababah narrated to us. Warqa narrated to me, from Abu al-Zinad, from al-A'raj, from Abu Hurayra, from the Prophet (peace be upon him), who said: Our lodging, if Allah wills, when Allah grants us victory, will be at al-Khayf, where they swore an oath concerning disbelief.
de: Zuhayr ibn Harb überlieferte mir. Shababah überlieferte uns. Warqa überlieferte mir, from Abu al-Zinad, from al-A'raj, from Abu Hurayra, from der Prophet (Friede sei auf ihm), who said: Our lodging, if Allah wills, when Allah grants us victory, will be at al-Khayf, wo they swore an oath concerning disbelief. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut dieser Überlieferung bleiben erhalten.

en: Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah narrated to us. Ibn Numayr and Abu Usamah both narrated to us. They said: Ubayd Allah narrated to us, from Nafi, from Ibn Umar. H; and Ibn Numayr narrated to us, and this is his wording: My father narrated to us. Ubayd Allah narrated to us. Nafi narrated to me, from Ibn Umar, that al-Abbas ibn Abd al-Muttalib asked the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) for permission to spend the nights of Mina in Makkah to provide water for the pilgrims, and he gave him permission.
de: Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah überlieferte uns. Ibn Numayr and Abu Usamah both überlieferte uns. They said: Ubayd Allah überlieferte uns, from Nafi, from Ibn Umar. H; and Ibn Numayr überlieferte uns, and this is his wording: My father überlieferte uns. Ubayd Allah überlieferte uns. Nafi überlieferte mir, from Ibn Umar, dass al-Abbas ibn Abd al-Muttalib asked der Gesandte Allahs (Friede sei auf ihm) for Erlaubnis to spend the nights of Mina in Makka to provide water for the Pilger, and he gave him Erlaubnis. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut dieser Überlieferung bleiben erhalten.

en: Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah and Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah's companions narrated to us. Ibn Bishr narrated to us, from Ibn Numayr. H; and Ibn Numayr narrated to us, and this is his wording: Abu Usamah narrated to us, from Ubayd Allah, from Nafi, from Ibn Umar, that the Prophet (peace be upon him) gave al-Abbas permission to spend the nights of Mina in Makkah to provide water for the pilgrims.
de: Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah and Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah's companions überlieferte uns. Ibn Bishr überlieferte uns, from Ibn Numayr. H; and Ibn Numayr überlieferte uns, and this is his wording: Abu Usamah überlieferte uns, from Ubayd Allah, from Nafi, from Ibn Umar, dass der Prophet (Friede sei auf ihm) gave al-Abbas Erlaubnis to spend the nights of Mina in Makka to provide water for the Pilger. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut dieser Überlieferung bleiben erhalten.

en: Muhammad ibn Mihran narrated to us. Abd al-Razzaq narrated to us, from Ibn Jurayj, who said: Ata told me, from Ibn Abbas. He said: The Prophet (peace be upon him) gave al-Abbas permission to spend the nights of Mina in Makkah to provide water for the pilgrims. Er sagte: Der Prophet (Friede sei auf ihm) gave al-Abbas Erlaubnis to spend the nights of Mina in Makka to provide water for the Pilger. en: Harmalah narrated to me. Ibn Wahb informed us. Yunus informed me, from Ibn Shihab, from Ubayd Allah ibn Abd Allah ibn Utbah, from Ibn Abbas, that the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) gave al-Abbas permission to spend the nights of Mina in Makkah to provide water for the pilgrims.
de: Harmalah überlieferte mir. Ibn Wahb berichtete uns. Yunus berichtete mir, from Ibn Shihab, from Ubayd Allah ibn Abd Allah ibn Utbah, from Ibn Abbas, dass der Gesandte Allahs (Friede sei auf ihm) gave al-Abbas Erlaubnis to spend the nights of Mina in Makka to provide water for the Pilger. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut dieser Überlieferung bleiben erhalten.

en: Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah narrated to us. Abu Usamah narrated to us, from Hisham, from his father, from Aisha, that she said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) gave al-Abbas permission to spend the nights of Mina in Makkah to provide water for the pilgrims.
de: Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah überlieferte uns. Abu Usamah überlieferte uns, from Hisham, from his father, from Aisha, dass she said: Der Gesandte of Allah (Friede sei auf ihm) gave al-Abbas Erlaubnis to spend the nights of Mina in Makka to provide water for the Pilger. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut dieser Überlieferung bleiben erhalten.

en: Ishaq ibn Ibrahim narrated to us. Sufyan informed us. Ishaq ibn Ibrahim said: Muadh ibn Hisham informed us. He said: My father informed me, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid, from Ibn Abi Layla, from Ali, from the Prophet (peace be upon him). There is no mention in their hadith of the reward of the slaughterer.
de: Ishaq ibn Ibrahim überlieferte uns. Sufyan berichtete uns. Ishaq ibn Ibrahim said: Muadh ibn Hisham berichtete uns. Er sagte: My father berichtete mir, from Ibn Abi Najih, from Mujahid, from Ibn Abi Layla, from Ali, from der Prophet (Friede sei auf ihm). There is no mention in their hadith of the reward of the slaughterer. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut dieser Überlieferung bleiben erhalten.

en: Muhammad ibn Hatim ibn Maymun, Muhammad ibn Marzuq, and Abd ibn Humayd narrated to me. Abd said: al-Akhiran narrated to us. They both said: Muhammad ibn Bakr narrated to us. Ibn Jurayj informed us. Al-Hasan ibn Muslim informed me that Mujahid informed him that Abd al-Rahman ibn Abi Layla informed him that Ali ibn Abi Talib informed him that the Prophet of Allah (peace be upon him) commanded him to stand over his sacrificial camel and commanded him to divide all its meat, skins, and coverings among the needy, and not to give any of them to the butcher as payment.
de: Muhammad ibn Hatim ibn Maymun, Muhammad ibn Marzuq, and Abd ibn Humayd überlieferte mir. Abd said: al-Akhiran überlieferte uns. They both said: Muhammad ibn Bakr überlieferte uns. Ibn Jurayj berichtete uns. Al-Hasan ibn Muslim berichtete mir dass Mujahid informed him dass Abd al-Rahman ibn Abi Layla informed him dass Ali ibn Abi Talib informed him dass the Prophet of Allah (Friede sei auf ihm) commanded him to stand over his Opferkamel and commanded him to divide all its meat, skins, and coverings among the needy, and not to give any of them to the butcher as payment. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut dieser Überlieferung bleiben erhalten.

en: Muhammad ibn Hatim narrated to me. Muhammad ibn Bakr narrated to us. Ibn Jurayj informed us. Abd al-Karim ibn Malik al-Jazari informed us that Mujahid informed him that Abd al-Rahman ibn Abi Layla informed him that Ali ibn Abi Talib informed him that the Prophet (peace be upon him) commanded him likewise.
de: Muhammad ibn Hatim überlieferte mir. Muhammad ibn Bakr überlieferte uns. Ibn Jurayj berichtete uns. Abd al-Karim ibn Malik al-Jazari berichtete uns dass Mujahid informed him dass Abd al-Rahman ibn Abi Layla informed him dass Ali ibn Abi Talib informed him dass der Prophet (Friede sei auf ihm) commanded him likewise. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut dieser Überlieferung bleiben erhalten.

en: Qutaybah ibn Sa'id narrated to us. Malik narrated to us. H; and Yahya ibn Yahya narrated to us, and this is his wording: I read to Malik, from Abu al-Zubayr, from Jabir ibn Abd Allah, who said: We slaughtered with the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) in the year of al-Hudaybiyyah: a camel for seven people and a cow for seven people.
de: Qutaybah ibn Sa'id überlieferte uns. Malik überlieferte uns. H; and Yahya ibn Yahya überlieferte uns, and this is his wording: I read to Malik, from Abu al-Zubayr, from Jabir ibn Abd Allah, who said: We slaughtered with der Gesandte Allahs (Friede sei auf ihm) in the year of al-Hudaybiyyah: a Kamel for seven Personen and a Kuh for seven Personen. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut dieser Überlieferung bleiben erhalten.

en: Yahya ibn Yahya narrated to us. Abu Khaythamah informed us, from Abu al-Zubayr, from Jabir. H; and Ahmad ibn Yunus narrated to us. Zuhayr narrated to us. Abu al-Zubayr narrated to us, from Jabir, who said: We went out with the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) while reciting the talbiyah for Hajj. The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) commanded us to share seven people in a camel and seven people in a cow, each group among us sharing one sacrificial camel.
de: Yahya ibn Yahya überlieferte uns. Abu Khaythamah berichtete uns, from Abu al-Zubayr, from Jabir. H; and Ahmad ibn Yunus überlieferte uns. Zuhayr überlieferte uns. Abu al-Zubayr überlieferte uns, from Jabir, who said: We went out with der Gesandte Allahs (Friede sei auf ihm) while reciting the talbiyah for Hadsch. Der Gesandte of Allah (Friede sei auf ihm) commanded us to share seven Personen in a Kamel and seven Personen in a Kuh, each group among us sharing one Opferkamel. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut dieser Überlieferung bleiben erhalten.

en: Muhammad ibn Hatim narrated to me. Waki narrated to us. Azrah ibn Thabit narrated to us, from Abu al-Zubayr, from Jabir ibn Abd Allah, who said: We performed Hajj with the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him), and we slaughtered a camel for seven people and a cow for seven people.
de: Muhammad ibn Hatim überlieferte mir. Waki überlieferte uns. Azrah ibn Thabit überlieferte uns, from Abu al-Zubayr, from Jabir ibn Abd Allah, who said: We performed Hadsch with der Gesandte Allahs (Friede sei auf ihm), and we slaughtered a Kamel for seven Personen and a Kuh for seven Personen. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut dieser Überlieferung bleiben erhalten.

en: Muhammad ibn Hatim narrated to me. Yahya ibn Sa'id narrated to us, from Ibn Jurayj. Abu al-Zubayr informed me that he heard Jabir ibn Abd Allah say: We shared with the Prophet (peace be upon him) in Hajj and Umrah, seven people to a sacrificial camel. A man said to Jabir: May a number of people share in a camel as they share in a slaughtered animal? He said: It is only a camel. Jabir was present at al-Hudaybiyyah. He said: We slaughtered seventy camels that day, and we shared seven people in each camel.
de: Muhammad ibn Hatim überlieferte mir. Yahya ibn Sa'id überlieferte uns, from Ibn Jurayj. Abu al-Zubayr berichtete mir dass he heard Jabir ibn Abd Allah say: We shared with der Prophet (Friede sei auf ihm) in Hadsch and Umra, seven Personen to a Opferkamel. A man said to Jabir: May a number of Personen share in a Kamel as they share in a slaughtered animal? Er sagte: It is only a Kamel. Jabir was present at al-Hudaybiyyah. Er sagte: We slaughtered seventy Kamels dass day, and we shared seven Personen in each Kamel. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut dieser Überlieferung bleiben erhalten.

en: Muhammad ibn Hatim narrated to me. Muhammad ibn Bakr narrated to us. Ibn Jurayj informed us. Abu al-Zubayr informed us that he heard Jabir ibn Abd Allah relating the Farewell Hajj of the Prophet (peace be upon him). He said: He commanded us, when we had entered the state of release, to sacrifice, and for a group of us to join together in a sacrificial animal. This was when he commanded them to release themselves from their Hajj in this hadith.
de: Muhammad ibn Hatim überlieferte mir. Muhammad ibn Bakr überlieferte uns. Ibn Jurayj berichtete uns. Abu al-Zubayr berichtete uns dass he heard Jabir ibn Abd Allah relating the Farewell Hadsch of der Prophet (Friede sei auf ihm). Er sagte: He commanded us, when we had entered the state of release, to Opfer, and for a group of us to join together in a Opfertier. This was when he commanded them to release themselves from their Hadsch in this hadith. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut dieser Überlieferung bleiben erhalten.

en: Yahya ibn Yahya narrated to us. Hushaym informed us, from Abd al-Malik, from Ata, from Jabir ibn Abd Allah, who said: We enjoyed the Umrah with the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him), so we slaughtered a cow for seven people and shared it among ourselves.
de: Yahya ibn Yahya überlieferte uns. Hushaym berichtete uns, from Abd al-Malik, from Ata, from Jabir ibn Abd Allah, who said: We enjoyed the Umra with der Gesandte Allahs (Friede sei auf ihm), so we slaughtered a Kuh for seven Personen and shared it among ourselves. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut dieser Überlieferung bleiben erhalten.

en: Uthman ibn Abi Shaybah narrated to us. Yahya ibn Zakariyya ibn Abi Za'idah narrated to us, from Ibn Jurayj, from Abu al-Zubayr, from Jabir, who said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) slaughtered a cow on behalf of Aisha on the Day of Sacrifice.
de: Uthman ibn Abi Shaybah überlieferte uns. Yahya ibn Zakariyya ibn Abi Za'idah überlieferte uns, from Ibn Jurayj, from Abu al-Zubayr, from Jabir, who said: Der Gesandte of Allah (Friede sei auf ihm) slaughtered a Kuh on behalf of Aisha on the Opfertag. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut dieser Überlieferung bleiben erhalten.

en: Muhammad ibn Hatim narrated to me. Muhammad ibn Bakr narrated to us. Ibn Jurayj narrated to us. H; and Sa'id ibn Yahya al-Umawi narrated to me. My father narrated to me. Ibn Jurayj narrated to us. Abu al-Zubayr informed me that he heard Jabir ibn Abd Allah say: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) slaughtered a cow on behalf of his wives. In Ibn Bakr's hadith, it says: on behalf of Aisha, a cow during his Hajj.
de: Muhammad ibn Hatim überlieferte mir. Muhammad ibn Bakr überlieferte uns. Ibn Jurayj überlieferte uns. H; and Sa'id ibn Yahya al-Umawi überlieferte mir. My father überlieferte mir. Ibn Jurayj überlieferte uns. Abu al-Zubayr berichtete mir dass he heard Jabir ibn Abd Allah say: Der Gesandte of Allah (Friede sei auf ihm) slaughtered a Kuh on behalf of his wives. In Ibn Bakr's hadith, it says: on behalf of Aisha, a Kuh during his Hadsch. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut dieser Überlieferung bleiben erhalten.

en: Yahya ibn Yahya narrated to us. Khalid ibn Abd Allah informed us, from Yunus, from Ziyad ibn Jubayr, that Ibn Umar came upon a man while he was slaughtering his sacrificial camel kneeling. He said: Make it stand, tied by one leg, according to the sunnah of your Prophet (peace be upon him).
de: Yahya ibn Yahya überlieferte uns. Khalid ibn Abd Allah berichtete uns, from Yunus, from Ziyad ibn Jubayr, dass Ibn Umar came upon a man while he was slaughtering his Opferkamel kneeling. Er sagte: Make it stand, tied by one leg, according to the Sunna of your Prophet (Friede sei auf ihm). Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut dieser Überlieferung bleiben erhalten.

en: Yahya ibn Yahya and Muhammad ibn Rumh both narrated to us. They said: Al-Layth informed us. H; and Qutaybah narrated to us. Al-Layth narrated to us, from Ibn Shihab, from Urwah ibn al-Zubayr and Amrah bint Abd al-Rahman, that Aisha said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him) used to send sacrificial animals from Madinah. I would twist the garlands of his sacrificial animals, then he would not avoid anything that a person in the state of ihram avoids.
de: Yahya ibn Yahya and Muhammad ibn Rumh both überlieferte uns. They said: Al-Layth berichtete uns. H; and Qutaybah überlieferte uns. Al-Layth überlieferte uns, from Ibn Shihab, from Urwah ibn al-Zubayr and Amrah bint Abd al-Rahman, dass Aisha said: Der Gesandte of Allah (Friede sei auf ihm) pflegte zu send Opfertiers from Madinah. I would twist the garlands of his Opfertiers, then he would not avoid anything dass a person in the state of ihram avoids. Die vollständige Überlieferungskette und der vollständige Wortlaut dieser Überlieferung bleiben erhalten.
